modules.name: Just Fiends
modules.description: Six linked slopes: envelopes, LFOs and oscillators that share one Time, spread by Intone. Every mode and Run mode is labelled, and a display shows all six shapes

modules.name: Weird Sisters
modules.description: Three linked filters (low, centre, high) around one frequency: crossover or formant, with resonance or a dry/wet blend. A display draws all three responses

modules.name: Mangrave
modules.description: Formant oscillator after the Mangrove technical map, with the PPM section built in: impulse, sync and cycle modes, trigger, to-air, sine, saw, PWM and hollow outputs. A scope shows the core and the impulses
